integrity_notes: The proof is analytic and self-contained; standalone finite matrix checks supplement but do not certify infinite-dimensional conclusions. An independent audit and priority certification have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the norm-closed algebra generated by root-preserving automorphism compositions on discrete Hardy spaces of homogeneous trees; it does not treat arbitrary symbols. The exact Hilbert-level pairwise chord gap is restricted to p=2. Abstract representation-theoretic priority equivalences remain possible.
title: Persistent-level rigidity for automorphism composition algebras on discrete Hardy spaces
